title: Binary Agreement for Efficient Unsupervised Confidence Calibration of Reasoning LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2604.19444v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reasoning language models often lack the calibrated confidence needed for reliable deployment, particularly when correctness labels are unavailable and sampling budgets are limited. We introduce Binary Agreement for Self-consistency Calibration (BASC), which uses self-consistency as an unlabeled proxy for correctness without constructing costly self-consistency targets for each calibration query. Our key observation is that agreement between an anchor response and a single independent probe is a Bernoulli observation whose conditional mean is the anchor's latent self-consistency. Pooling these observations across unlabeled queries, BASC supports both recalibrating existing confidence scores and learning more discriminative scores before recalibration, using as few as two responses per calibration query and only one at deployment. translated_title: 用于推理大语言模型高效无监督置信度校准的二元一致性方法
translated_abstract: 推理语言模型通常缺乏可靠部署所需的校准置信度，尤其是在正确性标签不可用且采样预算有限的情况下。我们提出了用于自洽性校准的二元一致性方法（BASC），该方法将自洽性用作正确性的无标签代理，而无需为每个校准查询构建代价高昂的自洽性目标。我们的关键观察是，锚定响应与单个独立探测响应之间的一致性是一个伯努利观测，其条件均值即为锚定响应的潜在自洽性。通过在无标签查询之间汇集这些观测，BASC既能对现有的置信度分数进行重新校准，也能在重新校准之前学习更具判别性的分数，每个校准查询仅需两个响应，部署时仅需一个响应。二元等渗回归重新校准的使用提供了无分布假设的校准保证……
tldr: BASC将锚定响应与单个独立探测响应之间的一致性视为伯努利观测来估计潜在自洽性，以每个校准查询仅需两个响应、部署时仅需一个响应的极低成本，实现了推理大语言模型的无监督置信度校准。
en_tdlr: BASC treats the agreement between an anchor response and a single independent probe as a Bernoulli observation to estimate latent self-consistency, enabling efficient unsupervised confidence calibration of reasoning LLMs with as few as two responses per calibration query and only one at deployment.
